source: hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki SkyBlock_Levels/Tasks (raw wikitext), Template:Heart_of_the_Mountain/Leveling_Table and Template:Heart_of_the_Forest/Leveling_Table, fetched 2026-11-24. Hypixel task IDs from leveling.completed_tasks in test/fixtures.
note: XP is from the wiki. Tasks with a Hypixel task ID are checked against the player's completed-task list; 'idSeen: false' marks an ID that follows its siblings' pattern but was never seen in a fixture, so a missing ID is treated as an estimate, not proof. Times are estimates unless the basis says otherwise. Essence shops: only Crimson, Diamond, Forest, Gold and Spider, whose perks rebuilt from task IDs add up exactly to the wiki's shop totals.
